AC2 (GATE-A/B pass — novel HIGH, no recurrence): fresh row, effective_severity >= HIGH, no open board row, recurrence_count < 2 → Opus DOES spawn (regression guard).

AC3 (GATE-B Tier 1 blocks — concrete MBB regression fixture): same (ticker,quarter,trigger_id) recurs while REFLOW-<ticker>-<quarter> (or any non-terminal row referencing guard_key) is open → NO Opus spawn; both locks released; row terminal. AC4 (GATE-B Tier 2 blocks — bootstrap net): no board row yet, but signals_processed holds >=2 rows with identical (type,ticker,quarter,trigger_id,context) → NO Opus spawn; reflow-needed-hint emitted to po; row terminal.
AC5 (GATE-B Tier 2 passes on count==1): no board row, first-ever occurrence → Opus spawns (never suppress genuine first finding).
AC6 (self-healing): board row transitions to TERMINAL_SET status → Tier 1 stops blocking even though recurrence_count remains >=2 (regression test for stuck-forever risk).

mandates: GATE-A: effective_severity = row.severity (top-level field, authoritative) with static ESC-id tier fallback (ONLY when row.severity missing); floor=HIGH from SignalSeverityEnum (orchStateSchema.ts:172); NOT max-of-both (would re-escalate shipped ESC-4 AC-2 INFO downgrade).

GATE-B Tier 1: read-only jq board-row-exists check on REFLOW-<ticker>-<quarter> (PO's live convention) with NON-terminal status per TERMINAL_SET (orchStateSchema.ts:58-64); self-healing on status flip to terminal.

Terminal Exit: both gates converge here on FAIL; release spawn_key (claimed in Step 2, must be freed immediately if gates decide not to spawn); release guard_key; mark row terminal per Step 6 pattern.

Injection safety: jq --arg/--argjson only, NEVER interpolate signal payload into /bin/sh; drain-signals.js CLI subcommand uses bound-param escaping (escB helper), matching existing sqlEsc() convention.

done_tasks.title: Derive alert/evidence confidence from in-scope strength, not frozen literals
done_tasks.promotion_note: BOUNDED-1 idle-capacity backlog pickup — WIP was 0; promoted top-priority unsupervised depends_on-eligible BACKLOG/TODO row (priority_rank=1)
done_tasks.review_note:
All 4 scheduler jobs' confidence is now derived from a real in-scope strength signal instead of a frozen literal, via a shared pure scorer deriveConfidenceFromStrength() (new domain/services/alertConfidenceScorer.ts: linear interpolation between base at strength=0 and ceiling at strength=1, clamped) fed by per-job base/ceiling constants in alertThresholds.ts. DB schema unchanged (confidence columns already REAL CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0.0 AND 1.0) in evidence_fragments; alerts.signals_json confidence field is a JSON number, not a column); every derived value stays within [0.55,0.95].

1) foreignFlowAlertJob.ts (commit c94c50e24): was flat confidence=0.75 on both the alert signal and the evidence fragment. Now uses the job's own pre-existing magnitude = min(1, |totalNetVolume3d| / 500_000) with FOREIGN_FLOW_CONFIDENCE_BASE=0.55 / CEILING=0.95. Example: 120k shares/3d (barely-HIGH, magnitude=0.24) -> confidence~=0.646; 600k shares/3d (capped, magnitude=1.0) -> confidence=0.95.

2) insiderCheckJob.ts (commit 0bb264fa2): was flat confidence=0.85 on both the streak evidence fragment and the streak alert row. Now uses the streak's own pre-existing magnitude = min(1, streak.buyDays / 10) with INSIDER_STREAK_CONFIDENCE_BASE=0.60 / CEILING=0.95 (shared local deriveStreakConfidence() so both writes always agree). Example: buyDays=3 (minimum qualifying streak) -> confidence~=0.705; buyDays=8 -> confidence~=0.88. The single-transaction buy-alert path (classifyInsiderTransaction) was already dynamic before this task and is untouched.

3) bbAlertScanJob.ts (commit 8d041fbb7): was flat confidence=0.65. New in-scope strength signal (none pre-existed): band-penetration ratio via new domain/services/bbBreakoutStrength.ts computeBbBreakoutStrength({close,upper,lower}) = how far close moved past the BB20 edge relative to the band's own width, clamped [0,1], with a fail-safe for a degenerate/inverted band. BB_BREAKOUT_CONFIDENCE_BASE=0.55 / CEILING=0.85 (lower ceiling than the HIGH-severity jobs — this is a warning-severity signal). Example (same 4,500-wide band): close 100 above upper -> confidence~=0.557; close 3,500 above upper -> confidence~=0.783.

4) taAlertScanJob.ts (commit 3978756bf): was flat confidence=0.7. New in-scope strength signal: RSI extremity via new domain/services/rsiExtremityStrength.ts computeRsiExtremityStrength({rsi,direction}) = distance past the 70/30 threshold normalised against the remaining span to saturation (100 or 0). RSI_EXTREME_CONFIDENCE_BASE=0.55 / CEILING=0.85. Example: RSI=71 (barely overbought) -> confidence=0.56; RSI=95 (deeply overbought) -> confidence=0.80. Deliberately does NOT use the job's unused macd field (ComputeTAResponse.macd is never otherwise read by this job) to avoid fabricating reliance on an unrelated metric — reasoning logged in the DJ-GATE-1 decision journal (sprint-SYSTEMIC-REMAKE-P1-dev-mcp-server.md STEP dev-mcp-server-S8).

p1_5.status: DECOMPOSITION RELEASED — po confirmed architect §6.5 (brief rev 2) on 2026-06-28T08:32:39Z (journal po-S6..S9). VERDICT: APPROVED-WITH-HARDENING.
p1_5.depends_on: P1 (needs owner_client_session to attribute an expired lock to a SPECIFIC dead session so a DIFFERENT same-role session can adopt it — impossible under owner_agent role-key)
p1_5.may_parallel: P2 (detection-by-staleness works pre-P2; detection precision improves once P2 presence roster lets the reaper cross-check an expired lock against the live-session roster)
p1_5.mechanism: Server-side reaper in the always-on mcp-server (the ONLY process alive across all session deaths) scans task_locks for expired locks (heartbeat_age > TTL) attributable to a dead session and emits an idempotent re-dispatch signal carrying a durable-checkpoint pointer; a live session ADOPTS and CONTINUES from the checkpoint (task_board status / handoff doc / period-keyed artifact) via stale-steal under its OWN owner_client_session — NOT a fresh restart; poison-task escalation after N retries stops infinite re-dispatch.
p1_5.design_ceiling_accepted: HONEST LIMIT, NOT A DEFECT: zero live sessions = zero execution. The reaper runs in mcp-server (a tool server, not an agent runtime) so it can only mark/keep state ADOPTABLE and emit the re-dispatch signal; actual takeover happens when the NEXT session comes online and reads that signal. Accepted by PO as an architectural limit.
dod_shape: Reaper detects orphan = lock expired (heartbeat_age > TTL) AND owner_client_session attributable to a non-live session (staleness pre-P2; cross-checked vs presence roster post-P2)
Orphaned work becomes ADOPTABLE: reaper emits an idempotent re-dispatch signal carrying the durable-checkpoint pointer (task_id + task_board status + handoff path + period-key)
A live session ADOPTS and CONTINUES from the durable checkpoint (not restart); adoption claims the expired lock via stale-steal with the adopter's owner_client_session
Idempotent continuation — NO double-publish of a period-keyed artifact (reuse published:<kind>:<period-key> dedup; honor guaranteed-slot double-post lesson)
Poison-task escalation: after N failed adoptions, stop re-dispatch, mark poisoned, route to po/BUG (no infinite loop)
Honest ceiling (zero live sessions = zero execution) documented + accepted; reaper runs in always-on mcp-server
RAW-verify against LIVE coordination.db in the Docker named volume

closed_sprint_goals.vision: Add a Cron Recheck Table to /dashboard/orchestration so the user can, at a glance, RECHECK every scheduled cron and see per-cron: expected schedule -> last actual fire -> expected next fire -> an HONEST liveness status (ON_TIME / LATE / MISSED / STALE / NEVER_FIRED). The table MUST be truthful about the TWO cron layers and never mis-flag a session-scoped CLI cron as a failure.
closed_sprint_goals.two_layer_honesty: Layer A = node-cron INSIDE mcp-server (server-hosted, always-on while container up) — these ARE trackable via cron_job_runs and classify ON_TIME/LATE/MISSED/STALE/NEVER_FIRED. Layer B = CLI CronCreate crons (.claude/commands/crons/*.md + cron-detect-loop/cron-cowork-team skills) — SESSION-SCOPED: they fire ONLY while a live CLI session hosts them and evaporate on session exit (memory: project_cowork_guaranteed_slot_needs_live_cli_session, feedback_no_remote_trigger_all_local). A Layer-B cron with no recent fire MUST render layer=cli-session + a NON-RED status (SESSION_SCOPED) with a reason — NEVER MISSED/failed.
closed_sprint_goals.scope_in: MULTI-zone (architect SPLITs; pm decomposes). (1) dev-mcp-server: a NEW cron-fire-status compute path + a READ-ONLY GET /api/cron-status REST handler mirroring interface/mcp/routes/orchestrationHandler.ts (register in server.ts). For EVERY Layer-A cron in the live CRONS map (apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/cronConfig.ts — SSOT; read the map, NEVER hardcode the list/count): parse the cron expr (node-cron dep already present) to derive expected_last_fire + expected_next_fire; read actual last_fire + last_status from cron_job_runs via cronJobRunStore using the MAX(started_at)-per-job pattern (double-log immune — same oracle schedulerWatchdogJob uses); classify status via cadence x threshold PARITY with schedulerWatchdogJob WATCHDOG_MANIFEST (generalize the 16-job manifest to ALL Layer-A crons — do NOT diverge the threshold). Reuse get_cron_health's last_run/last_status where already computed; the new endpoint EXTENDS it with expected-vs-actual, it does not duplicate run-store queries. (2) dev-mcp-server: surface Layer-B CLI crons HONESTLY — read them from their SSOT (.claude/commands/crons/*.md + system-map.json + the cron-detect-loop / cron-cowork-team skills), label layer=cli-session, status=SESSION_SCOPED (never MISSED). (3) dev-frontend: api.cron-status.tsx proxy resource route (mirror api.orchestration.tsx) + a Cron Recheck Table on dashboard.orchestration.tsx. Columns (plain-Vietnamese user copy where appropriate): Ten cron / Layer / Lich du kien (human-readable from expr) / Lan chay gan nhat / Du kien lan toi / Trang thai (colored badge). A RECHECK button re-fetches/revalidates the loader live. Per-table freshness badge 'Cap nhat luc' per the shipped freshness-transparency pattern (SSOT frontend-data-coverage-map.json — never baked/client-now time). (4) qa gate.
closed_sprint_goals.scope_out: NO new always-on cron/alerting (schedulerWatchdog already alerts — this is a READ-ONLY dashboard VIEW). NO auto-restart / auto-heal of crons from the UI (recheck is read-only). NOT changing any cron schedule or the CRONS map. NOT building a Layer-B run-tracking persistence store (session-scoped crons have no DB run rows BY DESIGN; surfacing them = label + last-known from skills SSOT, not new telemetry infra — deeper Layer-B telemetry is a follow-up). NOT reconciling/fixing individual broken crons (those are the existing FIX-CRON-* board tasks) — this sprint SURFACES status, it does not repair jobs.
closed_sprint_goals.success_metric: RAW-demonstrable: (a) GET /api/cron-status returns 200 with one row per Layer-A cron DERIVED from the live CRONS map (row count == map size, NOT a hardcoded number), each row carrying {name, layer:server, cron_expr, human_schedule, expected_last_fire, expected_next_fire, last_fire, last_status, status in {ON_TIME,LATE,MISSED,STALE,NEVER_FIRED}}. (b) A cron with a fresh cron_job_runs success row within its cadence classifies ON_TIME; a job whose MAX(started_at) exceeds cadence x threshold classifies MISSED/STALE, PARITY-tested against schedulerWatchdogJob's verdict for the same job (no divergence). (c) Layer-B CLI crons render layer=cli-session + a NON-RED SESSION_SCOPED status — a CLI cron with no recent fire is NOT shown MISSED/failed. (d) /dashboard/orchestration renders the table without error; RECHECK re-fetches live; 'Cap nhat luc' badge shows the REAL fetch time; a never-fired cron shows 'Chua tung chay' not a fabricated timestamp. (e) NO regression to the existing orchestration task-board view or /api/orchestration.
closed_sprint_goals.reuse_mandate: Anti-rebuild: CRONS map = SSOT for Layer-A exprs (read, never hardcode); cronJobRunStore MAX(started_at) = last-fire (double-log immune); schedulerWatchdogJob WATCHDOG_MANIFEST cadence/threshold = classification parity source (generalize, do NOT diverge); get_cron_health = existing last_run/last_status (extend, do NOT duplicate); orchestrationHandler.ts + api.orchestration.tsx = the exact REST+proxy pattern to mirror.
closed_sprint_goals.standing_acs: Carries the standing gates: freshness 'Cap nhat luc' (SSOT frontend-data-coverage-map.json, never client-now); no-fake-data (honest-NULL: never-fired -> 'Chua tung chay', no fabricated timestamp); plain-Vietnamese user-facing copy (feedback_language_boundary — English for work artifacts); all-info source/detail affordance where a status needs explanation (why MISSED / why SESSION_SCOPED).
